# Preparation dependencies

`pocket-music/` is an unmodified source snapshot of
https://github.com/zenibako/pocket-music at
`9cc67a266e2b9faea62ea89a3216d2dc3ee3134d` (2026-10-22).
It is MIT licensed; its original LICENSE and nested decoder licenses and
PATCHES.md files are retained. The checked-in project-made tone is a test
fixture, not purchased game audio. Root-module replacements select the
snapshot's patched decoders as well as its music/pack implementation.

The Pocket Sync protocol follows Butterscotch Pocket and Pico8Pocket.
No AGPL Butterscotch application implementation is copied into these tools.
